image_description: A white baby bib lying flat on a beige textured fabric surface. The bib features a terry cloth upper section and a cross-stitch patterned lower pocket area with the name 'LUCIA' embroidered in green thread. It has white binding around the edges and long white ties extending from the top corners.

To verify the legibility and structural integrity of the embroidered text, ensuring no AI gibberish or character fusion.
To check for clean boundaries between the bib and background, and ensure the ties are physically connected and not fused.
To analyze the consistency of the terry cloth loops and cross-stitch grid for any texture smearing or anomalies.

focus_areas: Texture consistency of terry cloth vs. woven fabric

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the embroidery. AI often struggles with regular grid patterns like cross-stitch. Check if the 'X' stitches are uniform or if they melt into each other. Verify the ties don't disappear into the background unnaturally.
